pages.title: Crystallised Law
pages.text: A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and froze before it could pop into a universe. It holds one rule completely, and nearby, that rule is slightly stronger than usual. Some feel heavier, some brighter; this one makes falling objects land softly.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Law Wraiths drop these when they dissolve. In the Axiom Distiller, I boiled a Primordial Law until one of its rules bubbled out on its own, and cooled it into a crystal.
